scope: User-provided 46-category prototype; not a regulatory determination

categories.name: Centralized data processing: Mainframes, Minicomputers
categories.visual_limit: Historical mainframes and minicomputers, mostly museum examples.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Personal Computers (Central Processing Unit with input and output devices)
categories.visual_limit: Desktop system units with monitors, keyboards and mice.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Laptop Computers (Central Processing Unit with input and output devices)
categories.visual_limit: Laptop and notebook terminology overlaps. Define a dataset rule for separating ITEW3 and ITEW4 before training.
categories.follow_up: Is this recorded as a laptop or notebook in the device specification?

categories.name: Notebook Computers
categories.visual_limit: Laptop and notebook terminology overlaps. Define a dataset rule for separating ITEW3 and ITEW4 before training.
categories.follow_up: Is this recorded as a notebook rather than a laptop in the device specification?

categories.name: Notepad Computers
categories.visual_limit: PROVISIONAL: pen-operated and early slate/convertible computers are candidates only. Confirm the meaning of Notepad Computers before assigning training labels; these overlap notebooks and tablets.
categories.follow_up: What does Notepad Computer mean in your inventory? Provide a model or device specification.

categories.name: Printers including cartridges
categories.visual_limit: 8 printer photos and 2 cartridge photos. Some printers also scan, copy or fax; apply a consistent primary-function rule.
categories.follow_up: Is this primarily a printer, a copier, or a standalone cartridge?

categories.name: Copying Equipment
categories.visual_limit: Copier-focused candidates including multifunction machines. May overlap ITEW6; confirm the model and primary function.
categories.follow_up: Is copying the primary function of this model?

categories.name: Electrical and Electronic Typewriters
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: User Terminal and Systems
categories.visual_limit: Historical video terminals and a thin client, rather than standalone desktop PCs.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Facsimile
categories.follow_up: Does the label or specification identify a fax machine?

categories.name: Telex
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Telephones
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Pay Telephones
categories.visual_limit: Some photos show a whole PCO booth. Annotate the telephone itself for device detection.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Cordless Telephones
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Cellular Telephones
categories.visual_limit: Keypad cellular phones in this starter selection. Smartphones also belong to the broader cellular-phone class.
categories.follow_up: What is the phone model, and does your phablet rule apply?

categories.name: Answering System
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Telecommunications transmission equipment
categories.visual_limit: Telecom transmission modules, multiplexing/access equipment and conferencing codecs. Apply your taxonomy's rules for this broad residual category.
categories.follow_up: Does a more specific telecom equipment category apply?

categories.name: BTS components excluding tower
categories.visual_limit: Radio units, base-station cabinets, baseband equipment and power modules; no tower structures. Ten images do not cover every possible BTS component.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Tablets, iPad
categories.visual_limit: iPad examples in this starter selection; additional brands would improve coverage.
categories.follow_up: Is this a tablet or a large-screen phone?

categories.name: Phablets
categories.visual_limit: Galaxy Note examples are provisional phablet candidates. Define a size/model rule to separate this class from ITEW15.
categories.follow_up: What phone models or screen-size rule count as phablets in your inventory?

categories.name: Scanners
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Routers
categories.visual_limit: Check model labels and WAN ports to distinguish routers from combined modem-router or optical-network devices.
categories.follow_up: Does this model include a modem, or is it a router only?

categories.name: GPS
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: UPS
categories.follow_up: Is this a computer UPS or a home inverter/UPS?

categories.name: Inverter
categories.visual_limit: Some photos include batteries. Annotate the inverter itself; home UPS and inverter marketing names overlap.
categories.follow_up: Is this a home inverter or a computer UPS?

categories.name: Modems
categories.visual_limit: Includes combined ADSL modem-router units. Verify modem functionality instead of classifying by antennas.
categories.follow_up: Does the model specification identify modem functionality?

categories.name: Electronic Data Storage Devices
categories.visual_limit: HDDs, SSDs and flash media. Some mixed lots include RAM or other components; exclude those from storage annotations.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Television sets, including LCD and LED televisions
categories.visual_limit: CRT and flat-screen television candidates. Distinguish TVs from CEEW6 monitors using model/tuner information.
categories.follow_up: Does this display include a television tuner or is it a monitor?

categories.name: Refrigerator
categories.visual_limit: Mostly single-door refrigerators plus a double-door example. Some photos show multiple units.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Washing Machine
categories.visual_limit: Top-load and front-load machines. Confirm the main object rather than packaging or adjacent appliances.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Air Conditioners, excluding centralized air-conditioning plants
categories.visual_limit: Five window-AC and five split-AC examples. Split photos may contain indoor and outdoor units; no centralized plant examples.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Fluorescent and other mercury-containing lamps
categories.visual_limit: Compact fluorescent lamps and disposal piles. Verify markings/technology; LED replacements can look similar. Some photos are close-ups or supplier product shots.
categories.follow_up: What lamp technology is printed on the bulb? Is it fluorescent rather than an LED replacement?

categories.name: Screen, Electronic Photo Frames, Electronic Display Panel, Monitors
categories.visual_limit: Seven monitor and three digital-photo-frame examples. For monitor photos containing other PC components, annotate the screen itself.
categories.follow_up: Is this a monitor/photo frame rather than a television?

categories.name: Radio Sets
categories.visual_limit: Portable transistor radio examples, including overseas vintage devices. The ten images do not exhaust radio form factors.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Set Top Boxes
categories.visual_limit: Set-top receivers, sometimes with remotes or accessories. Annotate the receiver unit.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Video Cameras
categories.visual_limit: Camcorder examples. Some cameras also take stills; use device type/model to separate CEEW9 and CEEW19.
categories.follow_up: Is this a dedicated camcorder or a still camera that also records video?

categories.name: Video Recorders
categories.visual_limit: VHS video recorder candidates, including stacked devices. Verify recording capability for player-only models before assigning CEEW10.
categories.follow_up: Can this device record video, or only play it?

categories.name: Hi-Fi Recorders
categories.visual_limit: Hi-fi cassette deck candidates. Verify recording capability using model or record controls, rather than assuming every tape player records.
categories.follow_up: Does this cassette deck record as well as play audio?

categories.name: Audio Amplifiers
categories.visual_limit: Audio amplifier examples, including PA and car amplifiers. Some photos include speakers.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Other equipment for recording/reproducing sound or images and distribution through telecommunications
categories.visual_limit: PROVISIONAL residual-category candidates: DVD/CD playback equipment. Confirm inclusion and precedence relative to other recording/reproduction categories.
categories.follow_up: Does a more specific audio/video category apply?

categories.name: Solar Panels/Cells, Solar Photovoltaic Panels/Cells/Modules
categories.visual_limit: Photovoltaic module and rooftop-array photos. These do not establish panel performance or discarded-waste status.
categories.follow_up: Confirm the device category shown.

categories.name: Luminaires for fluorescent lamps except household luminaires
categories.visual_limit: Commercial/industrial fluorescent-luminaire candidates. Vintage fittings may have been rewired or converted to LED; verify lamp type and intended non-household use.
categories.follow_up: Is this a non-household fluorescent fitting, and has it been converted to LED?

categories.name: High-intensity discharge lamps, including pressure sodium and metal-halide lamps
categories.visual_limit: High-pressure sodium and metal-halide candidates. Verify lamp markings; appearance alone cannot establish chemistry. Some photos contain multiple lamp types.
categories.follow_up: Do the lamp markings specify high-pressure sodium or metal halide?

categories.name: Low-pressure sodium lamps
categories.visual_limit: Low-pressure sodium SO/SOX candidates with U-shaped discharge tubes. Some collector images combine multiple photographic views; avoid treating these as independent examples.
categories.follow_up: Do the lamp markings specify low-pressure sodium (SO/SOX)?

categories.name: Other lighting/equipment for spreading or controlling light, excluding filament bulbs
categories.visual_limit: PROVISIONAL residual lighting candidates: LED stage and work/flood lights. No filament bulbs intentionally selected. Confirm coverage under your taxonomy.
categories.follow_up: What lighting technology is used, and does a more specific category apply?

categories.name: Digital Camera
categories.visual_limit: Compact digital still cameras. Add DSLR/mirrorless examples for wider coverage; video-capable still cameras can overlap CEEW9.
categories.follow_up: Is this primarily a digital still camera?
